value_en: Support the green and resilient development of the Brazilian Cerrado, through training and a public call for social and environmental interventions aimed at indigenous peoples, quilombolas and other traditional peoples and communities, contributing to reducing the impacts of climate change under the DGM (Dedicated Grant Mechanism for Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities) Brazil programme.

value_en: Support the strengthening of family farming in municipalities of the Amazon biome in the south-west region of the State of Mato Grosso, through the implementation and consolidation of agroforestry systems, support for collective production processing structures, and structuring of…

value_en: Support the strengthening of municipal environmental management, through the physical and operational structuring of the Municipal Secretariat for the Environment and Tourism.

value_pt: APOIAR O FORTALECIMENTO DA GESTAO ESCOLAR, A FORMACAO CONTINUADA DE PROFESSORES E A PARTICIPACAO DA COMUNIDADE ESCOLAR, EM ESCOLAS PUBLICAS DE ENSINO FUNDAMENTAL.

value_en: Support the strengthening of community forest management in the interior of the State of Amazonas through (I) support for sustainable production and marketing, II) strengthening of the Inatu Amazonia collective brand, and III) development of technological solutions for bottlenecks in the supported chains.

value_en: Acquisition of 60 Mississippi-standard bulk barges, 46 of the box model with capacity of 2,000 t and 14 of the raked model, of 1,800 t, to be built at the Bertolini Construcao Naval da Amazonia Ltda and Eram Estaleiro Rio Amazonas Ltda shipyards, located in Manaus/AM, and Rio Maguari S.A., located in Belem/PA, and acquisition of 2 azimuth-propulsion river pusher tugs with 2,400 kW of power to be built at the Bertolini Construcao Naval da Amazonia Ltda shipyard.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE 650 VAGOES FERROVIARIOS, SENDO 550 PARA TRANSPORTE DE GRAOS E 100 PARA TRANSPORTE DE OLEO COMESTIVEL ENTRE OS EST-PR, EST-SC E EST-RS
value_en: Acquisition of 650 railway rail cars, 550 for transporting grain and 100 for transporting edible oil between the states of PR, SC and RS.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE 650 VAGOES TIPO GRANELEIRO - TIPO HOOPER FECHADO (HTP) PELA ALL - AMERICA LATINA LOGISTICA MALHA NORTE S/A ATUALMENTE DENOMINADA RUMO MALHA NORTE S/A
value_en: Acquisition of 650 bulk-type closed hopper (HTP) rail cars by ALL - America Latina Logistica Malha Norte S/A, currently named Rumo Malha Norte S/A.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE 689 VAGOES, DIVIDIDOS ENTRE 403 VAGOES A SEREM FABRICADOS PELA RANDON; E 286 VAGOES A SEREM FABRICADOS PELA AMSTED MAXION, PREVISTA PARA OS ANOS DE 2012 E 2013, VISANDO AUMENTAR A CAPACIDADE DE TRANSPORTE DA EMPRESA
value_en: Acquisition of 689 rail cars, split between 403 rail cars to be manufactured by Randon, and 286 rail cars to be manufactured by Amsted Maxion, scheduled for the years 2012 and 2013, aimed at increasing the company's transport capacity.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE 75% DA PARTICIPACAO ACIONRIA DA SWIFT ARMOUR SOCIEDAD ANNIMA ARGENTINA, COM APORTE DE CAPITAL DE GIRO, VISANDO FORTALECER O PROCESSO DE INTERNACIONALIZAO DA EM- PRESA BRASILEIRA.
value_en: Acquisition of 75% of the equity interest in Swift Armour Sociedad Anonima Argentina, with a working capital contribution, aimed at strengthening the Brazilian company's internationalisation process.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE 80 VAGOES GRANELEIROS, COM CAPACIDADE DE 145 M3CADA, A SEREM UTILIZADOS PARA EXPORTACAO DE SOJA, NO TRECHODA MALHA FERROVIARIA ENTRE ALTO ARAGUAIA/MT E O PORTO DE SANTOS/SP. COORDENADOR: PASTORI
value_en: Acquisition of 80 bulk rail cars, with capacity of 145 m3 each, to be used for soybean exports, on the stretch of the rail network between Alto Araguaia/MT and the Port of Santos/SP. Coordinator: Pastori.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE 87 LOCOMOTIVAS E 2.936 VAGOES ATE 2015
value_en: Acquisition of 87 locomotives and 2,936 rail cars by 2015.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE 875 VAGOES E 50 LOCOMOTIVAS PARA O TRANSPORTE DE ACUCAR E OUTROS GRANEIS, DESTINADOS AO PORTO DE SANTOS
value_en: Acquisition of 875 rail cars and 50 locomotives for transporting sugar and other bulk products, bound for the Port of Santos.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATE 1.030 DEBENTURES DA GERADORA EOLICA BONS VENTOS DA SERRA I S.A., EM MONTANTE EQUIVALENTE A ATE R$ 10,3 MILHOES, NA DATA DE EMISSAO. FINALIDADE: PAGAMENTO E/OU REEMBOLSO DE GASTOS, DESPESAS OU DVIDAS RELACIONADOS A IIMPLANTAO E EXECUO DA CENTRAL GERADORA ELICA MALHADINHA I.
value_en: Acquisition of up to 1,030 debentures of the wind power generator Bons Ventos da Serra I S.A., in an amount equivalent to up to R$ 10.3 million, at the issue date. Purpose: payment and/or reimbursement of expenses, costs or debts related to the construction and operation of the Malhadinha I wind power plant.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATE 15 LOCOMOTIVAS E REVITALIZACAO DE ATE 50 LOCOMOTIVAS E AQUISICAO DE ATE 256 VAGOES NOVOS DOS TIPOS HOPPER E PLATAFORMA .
value_en: Acquisition of up to 15 locomotives and revitalisation of up to 50 locomotives, and acquisition of up to 256 new hopper- and platform-type rail cars.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATE 20.470 DEBENTURES DA VENTOS DE SAO TOME HOLDING S.A., EM MONTANTE EQUIVALENTE A ATE R$ 20,47 MILHOES, NA DATA DE EMISSAO. FINALIDADE: PAGAMENTOS FUTUROS OU REEMBOLSO DE GASTOS RELACIONADOS IMPLANTAO E EXPLORAO DAS SETE CENTRAIS GERADORAS ELICAS DO COMPLEXO CAETS.
value_en: Acquisition of up to 20,470 debentures of Ventos de Sao Tome Holding S.A., in an amount equivalent to up to R$ 20.47 million, at the issue date. Purpose: future payments or reimbursement of expenses related to the construction and operation of the seven wind power plants of the Caetes Complex.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATE 240 VAGOES TIPO HFT E IMPLANTACAO DE SISTEMA DE MANUTENCAO POR MEIO DE CONSTRUCAO E AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS PARA AUMENTAR O VOLUME TRANSPORTADO NA FERROVIA NORTESUL.
value_en: Acquisition of up to 240 HFT-type rail cars, and construction of a maintenance system through construction works and acquisition of equipment, to increase the volume transported on the Norte-Sul Railway.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATE 25 LOCOMOTIVAS TIPO AC44, QUE SERAO FABRICADAS NA PLANTA DE CONTAGEM-MG
value_en: Acquisition of up to 25 AC44-type locomotives, to be manufactured at the Contagem-MG plant.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATE 29 LOCOMOTIVAS E 1040 VAGOES NOVOS PARA O TRANSPORTE DE MINERIO DE FERRO E CARGA GERAL
value_en: Acquisition of up to 29 locomotives and 1,040 new rail cars for transporting iron ore and general cargo.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATE 85 MIL BICICLETAS ELETRICAS (E-BIKES) DESTINADAS A LOCACAO.
value_en: Acquisition of up to 85,000 electric bicycles (e-bikes) intended for rental.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATE 95 CAMINHOES TRATORES E DE ATE 139 SEMI-RE-BOQUES (IMPLEMENTOS) TRITREM PARA TRANSPORTE DE TORAS.
value_en: Acquisition of up to 95 truck tractors and up to 139 tri-train semi-trailers (implements) for log transport.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATIVOS DE PROPRIEDADE DA COPERIO - COOPERATIVA RIO DO PEIXE, LOCALIZADOS NO ESTADO DE SANTA CATARINA.
value_en: Acquisition of assets owned by Coperio - Cooperativa Rio do Peixe, located in the State of Santa Catarina.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE ATIVOS OPERACIONAIS E CAPITAL DE GIRO ASSOCIADO.
value_en: Acquisition of operating assets and associated working capital.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE CAMINHOES E EQUIPAMENTOS ESPECIAIS ADAPTAVEIS A CHASSIS.
value_en: Acquisition of trucks and special equipment adaptable to chassis.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE CAMINHOES E IMPLEMENTOS PARA TRANSPORTE DE MA- DEIRA.
value_en: Acquisition of trucks and implements for transporting timber.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE CINCO EMBARCACOES DE APOIO MARITIMO DO TIPO PSV(PLATFORM SUPPLY VESSEL), DE 4.500 TPB CADA UMA, IDENTIFICADAS PELOS CASCOS C-389 A C-393, DE CONSTRUCAO DO ESTALEIRO DETROIT, LOCALIZADO EM ITAJAI - SC. (COM SUPLEMENTACAO)
value_en: Acquisition of five PSV (platform supply vessel) offshore support vessels, of 4,500 dwt each, identified by hulls C-389 to C-393, built at the Detroit shipyard, located in Itajai - SC (with supplementation).

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURE SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DA 8A EMISSAO DE DEBENTURE DE AUTOPISTA REGIS BITTENCOURT. OSRECURSOS CAPTADOS PELAS DEBENTURES SERAO DESTINADOS AO REEM BOLSO DE DIVIDAS QUE FORAM CAPTADAS AO LONGO DE 2018 PARA A REALIZACAO DOS INVESTIMENTOS DA CONCESSAO (PORTARIA DO MINISTERIO DA INFRAESTRUTURA NO 3.051, DE 08/07/2019)
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the public offering of the 8th issuance of debentures of Autopista Regis Bittencourt. The funds raised through the debentures will be used to reimburse debts that were raised throughout 2018 to carry out the concession's investments (Ordinance of the Ministry of Infrastructure No. 3,051, of 08/07/2019).

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES "VERDES" CERTIFICADAS, EM OFERTA PUBLICA (ICVM 476), EMITIDAS PELA AMAZONIA SOLAR COMPANHIA SECURITIZADORA DE CREDITOS FINANCEIROS, COM CREDITOS ORIGINADOS PELA FINTECH SOLFACIL ENERGIA SOLAR TECNOLOGIA E SERVICOS FINANCEIROS LTDA., ESPECIALIZADA EM FINANCIAR A INSTALACAO DE SISTEMAS DE MICROGERACAO SOLAR FOTOVOLTAICA, PARA EXPANSAO ACELERADA DA GERACAO DISTRIBUIDA RENOVAVEL NA REGIAO NORTE.
value_en: Acquisition of certified "green" debentures, in a public offering (CVM Instruction 476), issued by Amazonia Solar Companhia Securitizadora de Creditos Financeiros, with receivables originated by the fintech Solfacil Energia Solar Tecnologia e Servicos Financeiros Ltda, specialised in financing the installation of solar photovoltaic micro-generation systems, for the accelerated expansion of distributed renewable generation in the North region.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES DA AUTOPISTA LITORAL SUL S.A., EM MONTANTE EQUIVALENTE A ATE R$ 152 MILHOES. AS DEBENTURES SERAODESTINADAS AO REEMBOLSO DE GASTOS, DESPESAS OU DIVIDAS RELA CIONADOS AOS INVESTIMENTO QUE VISAM A EXECUCAO E IMPLANTACAODO CONTORNO VIARIO DE FLORIANOPOLIS, QUE ABRANGE UMA EXTENS AO TOTAL DE 50 KM, COM PISTA DUPLA, 6 ACESSOS POR TREVOS, 4 TUNEIS, 7 PONTES E MAIS DE 20 PASSAGENS EM DESNIVEL E TEM COMO OBJETIVO DESVIAR O TRAFEGO DE LONGA DISTANCIA DO EIXO PRINCIPAL DA BR-101/SC.
value_en: Acquisition of debentures of Autopista Litoral Sul S.A., in an amount equivalent to up to R$ 152 million. The debentures will be used to reimburse expenses, costs or debts related to the investments aimed at the execution and construction of the Florianopolis bypass, which covers a total length of 50 km, with dual carriageway, 6 cloverleaf accesses, 4 tunnels, 7 bridges and more than 20 grade-separated crossings, and aims to divert long-distance traffic from the main BR-101/SC corridor.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA ENERGETICA DO MARANHAO EM MONTANTE DE ATE R$ 56 MILHOES, NA DATA DE EMISSAO, NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. FINALIDADE: QUITAO DE DVIDA DA EMISSORA; RECOMPOSIO DE CAIXA DA EMISSORA; CAPITAL DE GIRO DA EMISSORA
value_en: Acquisition of debentures of Companhia Energetica do Maranhao in an amount of up to R$ 56 million, at the issue date, under the company's public debenture offering. Purpose: settlement of the issuer's debt; replenishment of the issuer's cash; working capital of the issuer.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES DA ECO050 CONCESSIONARIA DE RODOVIASS/A, EM MONTANTE EQUIVALENTE A ATE R$ 550 MILHOES. AS DEBEN TURES SERAO DESTINADAS AOS INVESTIMENTOS QUE VISAM AO ATENDIMENTO DE OBRIGACOES CONTRATUAIS PREVISTAS NA CONCESSAO DO LOTE DE RODOVIAS COMPOSTO POR TRECHOS DA RODOVIA BR-050/GO/MG,OS QUAIS FORAM OBJETO DA CONCORRENCIA PUBLICA INTERNACIONAL NO 001/2013.
value_en: Acquisition of debentures of Eco050 Concessionaria de Rodovias S/A, in an amount equivalent to up to R$ 550 million. The debentures will be used for investments aimed at meeting contractual obligations set out in the concession of the highway lot comprising stretches of highway BR-050/GO/MG, which were the subject of international public tender No. 001/2013.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES DA ECO135 CONCESSIONARIA DE RODOVIASS/A, EM MONTANTE EQUIVALENTE A ATE R$ 520 MILHOES. AS DEBEN TURES SERAO DESTINADAS AOS INVESTIMENTOS QUE VISAM AO ATENDIMENTO DE OBRIGACOES CONTRATUAIS PREVISTOS NA CONCESSAO DO LOTE DE RODOVIAS COMPOSTO POR TRECHOS DAS RODOVIAS BR-135, MG-231 E LMG-754, AS QUAIS FORAM OBJETO DA CONCORRENCIA PUBLICAINTERNACIONAL NO 006/2017.
value_en: Acquisition of debentures of Eco135 Concessionaria de Rodovias S/A, in an amount equivalent to up to R$ 520 million. The debentures will be used for investments aimed at meeting contractual obligations set out in the concession of the highway lot comprising stretches of highways BR-135, MG-231 and LMG-754, which were the subject of international public tender No. 006/2017.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES DA VIA BRASIL BR-163 S.A., EM MONTANTE EQUIVALENTE A ATE R$ 150 MILHOES. AS DEBENTURES SERAO DESTINADAS AO REEMBOLSO DE GASTOS, DESPESAS OU DIVIDAS RELACIONADOS AOS INVESTIMENTOS QUE VISAM A EXECUCAO E IMPLANTACAO DOPLANO DE EXPLORACAO RODOVIARIA (PER) PREVISTO NA CONCESSAO DA BR-163/230/MT/PA.
value_en: Acquisition of debentures of Via Brasil BR-163 S.A., in an amount equivalent to up to R$ 150 million. The debentures will be used to reimburse expenses, costs or debts related to the investments aimed at executing and implementing the Road Operation Plan (PER) provided for in the concession of BR-163/230/MT/PA.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES DE EMISSAO DA CONCESSIONARIA DOS AEROPORTOS DA AMAZONIA S.A., EM MONTANTE EQUIVALENTE A ATE R$ 600 MILHOES, COM O OBJETIVO DE APOIAR A AMPLIACAO, A MANUTENCAO, A OPERACAO E A EXPLORACAO DOS AEROPORTOS DO BLOCO NORTE,OBJETO DO LEILAO PUBLICO INTERNACIONAL ANAC NO 01/2020 E DO CONTRATO NO 001/ANAC/2021-NORTE.
value_en: Acquisition of debentures issued by Concessionaria dos Aeroportos da Amazonia S.A., in an amount equivalent to up to R$ 600 million, aimed at supporting the expansion, maintenance, operation and exploitation of the airports of the North Block, subject of ANAC international public auction No. 01/2020 and contract No. 001/ANAC/2021-NORTE.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES EQUIVALENTE A ATE R$ 400 MILHOES. SERAO DESTINADAS AO REEMBOLSO DE GASTOS E DESPESAS EFETUADOS NOS 24 MESES ANTERIORES A DATA DE ENCERRAMENTO DA OFERTA RESTRITA E AOS INVESTIMENTOS FUTUROS REFERENTES AO CONTRATO DE CONCESSAO DO LOTE RODOVIARIO 05 DO EDITAL DE LICITACAO 002/2007, COMPREENDENDO: IMPLANTACAO DE 47,6 KM DE TERCEIRAS FAIXAS, 5 UNIDADES DE TREVOS EM DESNIVEL, RUAS LATERAIS EM PISTA SIMPLES, PASSARELAS SOBRE PISTAS DUPLAS, IMPLANTACAO DE BARREIRAS DE CONCRETO.
value_en: Acquisition of debentures equivalent to up to R$ 400 million. They will be used to reimburse expenses and costs incurred in the 24 months preceding the closing date of the restricted offering, and for future investments relating to the concession contract for highway lot 05 of tender notice 002/2007, comprising: construction of 47.6 km of third lanes, 5 grade-separated cloverleaf interchanges, single-carriageway side roads, pedestrian overpasses on dual carriageways, and installation of concrete barriers.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES DA 1A SERIE, A SER REALIZADAPELA UTE GNA II GERACAO DE ENERGIA S.A., EM MONTANTE EQUIVA LENTE A R$ 375 MILHOES PARA O APOIO A IMPLANTACAO DE UMA USINA TERMELETRICA MOVIDA A GAS NATURAL EM CICLO COMBINADO, DENOMINADA UTE GNA II, COM CAPACIDADE INSTALADA DE 1672,6 MW, LOCALIZADA NO PORTO DO ACU, EM SAO JOAO DA BARRA (RJ), BEM COMO DO RESPECTIVO SISTEMA DE TRANSMISSAO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures of the 1st series, to be issued by UTE GNA II Geracao de Energia S.A., in an amount equivalent to R$ 375 million, to support the construction of a combined-cycle natural gas thermoelectric plant, called UTE GNA II, with installed capacity of 1,672.6 MW, located at the Porto do Acu, in Sao Joao da Barra (RJ), as well as its associated transmission system.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS CAPTADOS POR MEIO DA EMISSO SERO DESTINADOS AO FINANCIAMENTO DE INVESTIMENTO COMPOSTO PELAS LINHAS DE TRANSMISSO 230 KV SAMUEL ARIQUEMES, ARIQUEMES JI-PARAN, JI-PARAN PIMENTA BUENO, PIMENTA BUENO VILHENA, VILHENA JAURU, SUBESTAES ASSOCIADAS NO ESTADO DE RONDNIA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds raised through the issuance will be used to finance an investment comprising the 230 kV Samuel-Ariquemes, Ariquemes-Ji-Parana, Ji-Parana-Pimenta Bueno, Pimenta Bueno-Vilhena, Vilhena-Jauru transmission lines and associated substations in the State of Rondonia.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS CAPTADOS SERO UTILIZADOS PARA A VIABILIZAO E IMPLEMENTAO DAS 50 UNIDADES GERADORAS DA UHE SANTO ANTNIO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds raised will be used to enable and implement the 50 generating units of the Santo Antonio hydroelectric plant (UHE).

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS A SEREM OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA POR MEIO DA OFERTA SERO MANTIDOS, IMEDIATAMENTE APS A DATA DE LIQUIDAO, EM CAIXA E/OU JUNTO A INSTITUIES FINANCEIRAS DE PRIMEIRA LINHA, EM DEPSITOS A VISTA OU APLICAES FINANCEIRAS DE CURTO PRAZO E DE ALTA LIQUIDEZ. POSTERIORMENTE, A EMISSORA PODER UTILIZAR OS RECURSOS OBTIDOS POR MEIO DA OFERTA PARA A AQUISIO DE PARTICIPAO EM SHOPPING CENTERS, PARTICIPAO EM NOVOS IMVEIS, PARA NOVOS INVESTIMENTOS OU REINVESTIMENTOS EM IMVEIS DE SUA PROPRIEDADE.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds to be obtained by the issuer through the offering will be held, immediately after the settlement date, in cash and/or with top-tier financial institutions, in demand deposits or short-term, highly liquid financial investments. Subsequently, the issuer may use the proceeds obtained through the offering to acquire interests in shopping centres, interests in new properties, for new investments, or for reinvestment in properties it owns.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA COMPANHIA COM A EMISSO DAS DEBNTURES SERO INTEGRALMENTE UTILIZADOS PARA O PAGAMENTO DE NOTAS COMERCIAIS, EMITIDAS EM 01 DE MARO DE 2013, SENDO QUE OS RECURSOS CAPTADOS MEDIANTE A EMISSO DAS NOTAS COMERCIAIS FORAM DESTINADOS PARA O FINANCIAMENTO DO PROGRAMA DE INVESTIMENTO DA EXPANSO, MANUTENO E SUPORTE DA REDE DE DISTRIBUIO DE GS NATURAL, BEM COMO CONEXO DE NOVOS CLIENTES DA EMISSORA, NA REGIO DO VALE DO PARABA, BAIXADA SANTISTA, REGIO METROPOLITANA DE SO PAULO E INTERIOR DO ESTADO, SENDO DESTINADOS AINDA A PROJETOS DE TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMAO DA EMISSORA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the company from the issuance of the debentures will be used entirely to pay commercial notes, issued on 1 March 2013, the proceeds of which were used to finance the investment programme for the expansion, maintenance and support of the natural gas distribution network, as well as connection of new customers of the issuer, in the Vale do Paraiba region, Baixada Santista, the Sao Paulo metropolitan region and the interior of the state, and were also used for the issuer's information technology projects.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA COMPANHIA COM A EMISSO SERO INTEGRALMENTE UTILIZADOS PARA (I) COM RELAO S DEBNTURES DA PRIMEIRA SRIE E S DEBNTURES DA SEGUNDA SRIE, REFORO DE CAIXA DA COMPANHIA; E (II) COM RELAO AS DEBNTURES DA TERCEIRA SRIE, OS INVESTIMENTOS DA COMPANHIA RELATIVOS SAFRA DO ANO DE 2013/2014, TANTO EM SUA REA AGRCOLA COMO EM SUA REA INDUSTRIAL.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the company from the issuance will be used entirely for: (I) with respect to the first-series and second-series debentures, reinforcement of the company's cash; and (II) with respect to the third-series debentures, the company's investments relating to the 2013/2014 harvest, in both its agricultural and industrial areas.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA COM A OFERTA RESTRITA SERO DESTINADOS PARA TODAS OU QUALQUER UMA DAS SEGUINTES FINALIDADES: (A) AQUISIO DE PARTICIPAO EM EMPREENDIMENTOS; (B) INVESTIMENTOS EM NOVOS PROJETOS "GREENFIELD"; E ( C) REFORO DE CAPITAL DE GIRO DA EMISSORA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer with the restricted offering will be used for any or all of the following purposes: (a) acquisition of interests in ventures; (b) investments in new "greenfield" projects; and (c) reinforcement of the issuer's working capital.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA COM A OFERTA SERO UTILIZADOS PARA FAZER FRENTE A PARTE DO PLANO DE INVESTIMENTO CONSOLIDADO DA EMISSORA PARA O TRINIO 2012/2014, DA ORDEM DE R$1,6 BILHES, DOS QUAIS R$927 MILHES SERO ALOCADOS EM GERAO DE ENERGIA ELTRICA POR FONTES RENOVVEIS. DOS INVESTIMENTOS EM GERAO, DESTACAM-SE 5 PARQUES ELICOS NO RIO GRANDE DO NORTE E UMA PEQUENA CENTRAL HIDRELTRICA NO ESTAO DE MINAS GERAIS.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer with the offering will be used to cover part of the issuer's consolidated investment plan for the 2012/2014 three-year period, of around R$1.6 billion, of which R$927 million will be allocated to electricity generation from renewable sources. Among the generation investments are 5 wind farms in Rio Grande do Norte and a small hydroelectric plant in the State of Minas Gerais.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA COM A OFERTA SERO UTILIZADOS PARA O RESGATE ANTECIPADO TOTAL E A LIQUIDAO INTEGRAL DAS DEBNTURES DA PRIMEIRA SRIE EM CIRCULAO, DA PRIMEIRA EMISSO DA EMISSORA, SENDO O SALDO REMANESCENTE UTILIZADO PARA O REFORO DE CAPITAL DE GIRO, A RECOMPOSIO DE CAIXA E DISTRIBUIO DE DIVIDENDOS AOS ACIONISTAS.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer with the offering will be used for the total early redemption and full settlement of the outstanding first-series debentures of the issuer's first issuance, with the remaining balance used to reinforce working capital, replenish cash, and distribute dividends to shareholders.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA COM A OFERTA SERO UTILIZADOS PARA REFORO DO SEU CAPITAL DE GIRO E ALONGAMENTO DO PERFIL DE SUA DVIDA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer with the offering will be used to reinforce its working capital and lengthen its debt maturity profile.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA COM A OFERTA SERO UTILIZADOS, INTEGRALMENTE, PARA: (I) REFINANCIAMENTO DE DVIDAS DA EMISSORA DE OUTRO PRAZO; E/OU (II) REALIZAO DE PLANO DE INVESTIMENTOS - CAPEX DA EMISSORA; E/OU (III) REFORO DE CAPITAL DE GIRO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer with the offering will be used entirely for: (I) refinancing of the issuer's other-term debts; and/or (II) execution of the issuer's investment plan - CAPEX; and/or (III) reinforcement of working capital.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA POR MEIO DA INTEGRALIZAO DAS DEBNTURES SERO DESTINADOS DA SEGUINTE FORMA E NA SEGUINTE PROPORO: (I) APROXIMADAMENTE 42% PARA O RESGATE DAS 64 NOTAS PROMISSRIAS DA 5 EMISSO DA EMISSORA; (II) APROXIMADAMENTE 38% PARA O RESGATE DAS 60 NOTAS PROMISSRIAS DA 6 EMISSO; E (III) O SALDO REMANESCENTE, EQUIVALENTE A APROXIMADAMENTE 20% DOS RECURSOS LQUIDOS SER UTILIZADO PARA INVESTIMENTO EM OBRAS DESTINADAS A AMPLIAR, RENOVAR E MELHORAR A ESTRUTURA DE DISTRIBUIO DE ENERGIA ELTRICA DA EMISSORA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer through the debenture subscription will be used as follows and in the following proportion: (I) approximately 42% for the redemption of the 64 promissory notes of the issuer's 5th issuance; (II) approximately 38% for the redemption of the 60 promissory notes of the 6th issuance; and (III) the remaining balance, equivalent to approximately 20% of the net proceeds, will be used for investment in works to expand, renew and improve the issuer's electricity distribution structure.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA POR MEIO DA INTEGRALIZAO DAS DEBNTURES SERO DESTINADOS PARA O RESGATE DAS 100 NOTAS PROMISSRIAS COMERCIAIS DA 4 EMISSO DA COMPANHIA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer through the debenture subscription will be used for the redemption of the 100 commercial promissory notes of the company's 4th issuance.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA POR MEIO DA OFERTA, SERO DESTINADOS, NESTA ORDEM DE ALOCAO, AO (A) RESGATE ANTECIPADO DA TOTALIDADE DAS NOTAS PROMISSRIAS DA 4 EMISSO, (B) RESGATE ANTECIPADO TOTAL OU RESGATE ANTECIPADO PARCIAL DAS NOTAS PROMISSRIAS DA 5 EMISSO; E (C) AO REFORO DE CAIXA DA COMPANHIA, CASO SOBEJEM RECURSOS APS A REALIZAO DOS ITENS (A) E (B) ANTERIORES.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer through the offering will be used, in this order of allocation, for (a) the early redemption of all the promissory notes of the 4th issuance, (b) the full or partial early redemption of the promissory notes of the 5th issuance; and (c) reinforcement of the company's cash, should funds remain after carrying out items (a) and (b) above.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA COM A OFERTA RESTRITA SERO DESTINADOS CONSTRUO, OPERAO E MANUTENO DAS INSTALAES DE TRANSMISSO CARACTERIZADAS NO ANEXO 6G-CC DO EDITAL DO LEILO N 007/2008-ANEEL, RELATIVAS SEGUNDA LINHA DE TRANSMISSO DE CORRENTE CONTNUA DE, APROXIMADAMENTE, 600 KV, CIRCUITO SIMPLES, COM EXTENSO DE, APROXIMADAMENTE, 2375 KM, COM ORIGEM NA SUBESTAO COLETORA PORTO VELHO, NO ESTADO DE RONDNIA E TRMINO NA SUBESTAO ARARAQUARA 2, NO ESTADO DE SO PAULO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds obtained by the issuer with the restricted offering will be used for the construction, operation and maintenance of the transmission facilities described in Annex 6G-CC of the notice of ANEEL auction No. 007/2008, relating to the second direct-current transmission line of approximately 600 kV, single circuit, with a length of approximately 2,375 km, originating at the Porto Velho collector substation, in the State of Rondonia, and ending at the Araraquara 2 substation, in the State of Sao Paulo.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS OBTIDOS POR MEIO DA EMISSO DAS DEBNTURES SERO UTILIZADOS PARA (I) O PROGRAMA DE INVESTIMENTOS DA EMISSORA, COMPREENDENDO DESENVOLVIMENTO INSTITUCIONAL E OPERACIONAL, CONSTRUO, MODERNIZAO, AMPLIAO DE SISTEMAS DE ABASTECIMENTO DE GUA E ESGOTAMENTO SANITRIO, DESAPROPRIAO DE TERRENOS, INDENIZAO DE ATIVOS DE NOVAS CONCESSES E INVESTIMENTOS EM SERVIOS DE ABASTECIMENTO DE GUA SAA E SERVIOS DE ESGOTAMENTO SANITRIO SES, EXECUTADOS COM RECURSOS DA EMISSORA EM PARCERIA COM OS MUNICPIOS NOS QUAIS A EMISSORA TEM A CONCESSO DESSES SERVIOS, NO PERODO COMPREENDIDO ENTRE OS ANOS DE 2012 E 2014, BEM COMO (II) O ALONGAMENTO DO PERFIL DE DVIDA DA EMISSORA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds obtained through the issuance of the debentures will be used for (I) the issuer's investment programme, comprising institutional and operational development, construction, modernisation and expansion of water supply and sewerage systems, expropriation of land, compensation for assets of new concessions, and investments in water supply services (SAA) and sewerage services (SES), carried out with the issuer's funds in partnership with the municipalities in which the issuer holds the concession for these services, in the period between 2012 and 2014, as well as (II) lengthening the issuer's debt maturity profile.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS OBTIDOS POR MEIO DA EMISSO DAS DEBNTURES SERO UTILIZADOS PARA: (I) AT 66% PARA O RESGATE DE DEBNTURES DA SUA PRIMEIRA EMISSO NO MBITO DA OFERTA DE RESGATE ANTECIPADO DAS DEBNTURES DA PRIMEIRA EMISSO; E (II) NO MNIMO, 34% PARA O REFORO DO CAPITAL DE GIRO DA COMPANHIA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds obtained through the issuance of the debentures will be used for: (I) up to 66% for the redemption of debentures of its first issuance under the early redemption offer of the first-issuance debentures; and (II) at least 34% for reinforcement of the company's working capital.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS PROVENIENTES DA CAPTAO POR MEIO DA EMISSO DAS DEBNTURES SERO DESTINADOS DA SEGUINTE FORMA: (I) 44,8% PARA VIABILIZAO E IMPLEMENTAO DE PROJETOS DE INVESETIMENTO NA REA DE INFRAESTRUTURA, E (II) 55,2% PARA O RESGATE ANTECIPADO DA TOTALIDADE DAS DEBNTURES DA PRIMEIRA EMISSO PBLICA DA EMISSORA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds raised through the issuance of the debentures will be used as follows: (I) 44.8% to enable and implement investment projects in the infrastructure area, and (II) 55.2% for the early redemption of all the debentures of the issuer's first public issuance.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS PROVENIENTES DA CAPTAO POR MEIO DA EMISSO DAS DEBNTURES SERO DESTINADOS, EXCLUSIVAMENTE, DA SEGUINTE FORMA: (I) R$500.000.000,00 PARA LIQUIDAO DE COMPROMISSOS FINANCEIRAS VINCENDOS EM 2013, E (II) R$500.000.000,00 PARA O RESGATE ANTECIPADO DAS DEBNTURES OBJETO DA 16 EMISSO DE DEBNTURES DA EMISSORA OU OUTRA DVIDA DA COMPANHIA, A SEU CRITRIO. VALORES REMANESCENTES OBTIDOS POR MEIO DA EMISSO DAS DEBNTURES SERO UTILIZADOS PARA REFORO DE CAIXA DA COMPANHIA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds raised through the issuance of the debentures will be used exclusively as follows: (I) R$500,000,000.00 to settle financial commitments falling due in 2013, and (II) R$500,000,000.00 for the early redemption of the debentures of the issuer's 16th debenture issuance or other company debt, at its discretion. Remaining amounts obtained through the issuance of the debentures will be used to reinforce the company's cash.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS PROVENIENTES DA CAPTAO POR MEIO DA EMISSO DE DEBNTURES SERO DESTINADOS LIQUIDAO DE COMPROMISSOS FINANCEIROS VINCENDOS AT 31 DE DEZEMBRO DE 2012.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds raised through the issuance of debentures will be used to settle financial commitments falling due by 31 December 2012.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBNTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS CAPTADOS SERO UTILIZADOS PARA A RECOMPOSIO DE CAIXA DA EMISSORA, EM RAZO DO PAGAMENTO DE SUAS DVIDAS.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds raised will be used to replenish the issuer's cash, due to the payment of its debts.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBNTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS LQUIDOS OBTIDOS PELA EMISSORA POR MEIO DA EMISSO SERO UTILIZADOS PARA O RESGATE DE AES PREFERENCIAIS RESGATVEIS EM POSSE DOS ACIONISTAS DA EMISSORA E PARA REALIZAR O PAGAMENTO FUTURO OU REEMBOLSO DE GASTOS, DESPESAS OU DVIDAS RELACIONADOS A INVESTIMENTOS EM ATIVOS FIXOS NOS PROJETOS DO COMPLEXO ELICO POR MEIO DAS CENTRAIS GERADORAS ELICAS DENOMINADAS VERACE I, VERACE II, VERACE III, VERACE IV, VERACE V, VERACE VI, VERACE VII, VERACE VIII, VERACE IX E VERACE X .
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The net proceeds obtained by the issuer through the issuance will be used for the redemption of redeemable preferred shares held by the issuer's shareholders, and to make future payment or reimbursement of expenses, costs or debts related to investments in fixed assets in the wind complex projects, through the wind power plants called Verace I, Verace II, Verace III, Verace IV, Verace V, Verace VI, Verace VII, Verace VIII, Verace IX and Verace X.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO AMBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBNTURES DA COMPANHIA.OS RECURSOS CAPTADOS SERO UTILIZADOS PARA O DESENVOLVIMENTO DA FASE I- B DO PROJETO DESCRITO NO CONTRATO DE CONCESSO, QUE ABRANGE A AMPLIAO DO AEROPORTO INTERNACIONAL DE GUARULHOS PARA ADEQUAO DA INFRAESTRUTURA E MELHORIA DO NVEL DE SERVIOS.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds raised will be used for the development of Phase I-B of the project described in the concession contract, which covers the expansion of Guarulhos International Airport to upgrade infrastructure and improve the level of service.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES NO MBITO DA OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBNTURES DA COMPANHIA. OS RECURSOS SERO UTILIZADOS PARA: (I) A REALIZAO DE INVESTIMENTOS NO AEROPORTO INTERNACIONAL DE VIRACOPOS RELATIVOS REALIZAO DE OBRAS EMERGENCIAIS E (II) IMPLANTAO (A) DO NOVO TERMINAL DE PASSAGEIROS TPS; (B) REAS DE TAXIAMENTO; (C) PTIO DE AERONAVES; (D) NOVAS REAS DE ESTACIONAMENTO (EDIFCIO GARAGEM, NOVO ESTACIONAMENTO DE CAMINHES, ESTACIONAMENTO PARA CARROS A SEREM ALUGADOS, REA PARA ESTACIONAMENTO DE TXIS E ESTACIONAMENTO PARA VECULOS QUE PERMANECERO POR LONGOS PERODOS); (E) OBRAS DE INFRAESTRUTURA BSICA (NOVA SUBESTAO E ESTRUTURAS PARA ARMAZENAMENTO E DISTRIBUIO DE GUA PARA ABASTECIMENTO E COMBATE A INCNDIO); E (F) VIAS DE ACESSO INTERNAS (ACESSO AO NOVO TPS E MELHORIAS NO ACESSO EXISTENTE AOS TERMINAIS DE PASSAGEIROS E CARGA), CORRESPONDENTES FASE I-B ESTABELECIDA NO CONTRATO DE CONCESSO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures under the company's public debenture offering. The funds will be used for: (I) carrying out investments at Viracopos International Airport related to emergency works, and (II) construction of (a) the new passenger terminal (TPS); (b) taxiing areas; (c) aircraft apron; (d) new parking areas (parking garage building, new truck parking, car rental parking, taxi parking area, and parking for long-stay vehicles); (e) basic infrastructure works (new substation and structures for storing and distributing water for supply and fire-fighting); and (f) internal access roads (access to the new TPS and improvements to existing access to the passenger and cargo terminals), corresponding to Phase I-B set out in the concession contract.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES, EMITIDAS PELA ENERGISA ACREDISTRIBUIDORA DE ENERGIA S.A., EM MONTANTE DE ATE R$ 220 MI LHOES, PARA APOIO AO SEU PLANO DE INVESTIMENTO, CONFORME DEFINIDO NA RESPECTIVA ESCRITURA DE EMISSAO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures, issued by Energisa Acre Distribuidora de Energia S.A., in an amount of up to R$ 220 million, to support its investment plan, as defined in the respective issuance deed.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES, EMITIDAS PELA ENERGISA MATOGROSSO DISTRIBUIDORA DE ENERGIA S.A., EM MONTANTE DE ATE R$ 370 MILHOES PARA APOIO AO SEU PLANO DE INVESTIMENTO, CONFOR ME DEFINIDO NA RESPECTIVA ESCRITURA DE EMISSAO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures, issued by Energisa Mato Grosso Distribuidora de Energia S.A., in an amount of up to R$ 370 million, to support its investment plan, as defined in the respective issuance deed.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES, EMITIDAS PELA ENERGISA TOCANTINS DISTRIBUIDORA DE ENERGIA S.A., EM MONTANTE DE ATE R$ 460 MILHOES PARA APOIO AO SEU PLANO DE INVESTIMENTO, CONFORMEDEFINIDO NA RESPECTIVA ESCRITURA DE EMISSAO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures, issued by Energisa Tocantins Distribuidora de Energia S.A., in an amount of up to R$ 460 million, to support its investment plan, as defined in the respective issuance deed.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES, EMITIDAS PELA GRANDE SERTAOI TRANSMISSORA DE ENERGIA S.A., NO MONTANTE DE ATE R$ 239,4 MILHOES, DESTINADAS A IMPLANTACAO DAS INSTALACOES PREVISTAS NO CONTRATO DE CONCESSAO DE SERVICO PUBLICO DE TRANSMISSAO NO 07/2024-ANEEL.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures, issued by Grande Sertao I Transmissora de Energia S.A., in an amount of up to R$ 239.4 million, intended for the construction of the facilities provided for in transmission public service concession contract No. 07/2024-ANEEL.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES, EMITIDAS PELA GRANDE SERTAOIII TRANSMISSORA DE ENERGIA S.A., EM MONTANTE DE ATE R$ 905 MILHOES, DESTINADAS A IMPLANTACAO DAS INSTALACOES PREVISTAS NO CONTRATO DE CONCESSAO DE SERVICO PUBLICO DE TRANSMISSAO NO 17/2024-ANEEL (LINHA DE TRANSMISSAO OUROLANDIA II JUSSIAPE, EM CIRCUITO DUPLO, E EXPANSAO DA SUBESTACAO OUROLANDIA II), LOCALIZADAS NO ESTADO DA BAHIA.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures, issued by Grande Sertao III Transmissora de Energia S.A., in an amount of up to R$ 905 million, intended for the construction of the facilities provided for in transmission public service concession contract No. 17/2024-ANEEL (the Ourolandia II-Jussiape double-circuit transmission line, and expansion of the Ourolandia II substation), located in the State of Bahia.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES, EMITIDAS PELA VERDE TRANSMISSAO DE ENERGIA S.A., DESTINADAS A IMPLANTACAO DE INSTALACOES DE TRANSMISSAO, OBJETO DO CONTRATO DE CONCESSAO DO SERVICOPUBLICO DE TRANSMISSAO DE ENERGIA ELETRICA NO 06/2022-ANEEL , LICITADAS POR MEIO DO LOTE 01 DO LEILAO ANEEL NO 01/2022, E REFORCOS AUTORIZADOS POR MEIO DO DESPACHO ANEEL NO 644 DE 11/03/2025, LOCALIZADAS NOS ESTADOS DE MINAS GERAIS E SAO PAULO.
value_en: Acquisition of simple debentures, issued by Verde Transmissao de Energia S.A., intended for the construction of transmission facilities, subject of the electricity transmission public service concession contract No. 06/2022-ANEEL, tendered under Lot 01 of ANEEL auction No. 01/2022, and reinforcements authorised by ANEEL Order No. 644 of 11/03/2025, located in the states of Minas Gerais and Sao Paulo.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DOIS EQUIPAMENTOS PARA O SETOR DE RADIOTERAPIA DO HOSPITAL DE CANCER DE BARRETOS.
value_en: Acquisition of two pieces of equipment for the radiotherapy department of Hospital de Cancer de Barretos.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DUAS EMBARCACOES DE APOIO MARITIMO DA CLASSE PSV 5.000, MODELO MULTIPROPOSITO HIBRIDO, IDENTIFICADAS PELOS CASCOS C430 E C431, A SEREM CONSTRUIDAS PELO ESTALEIRO DETROIT BRASIL, EM ITAJAI (SC).
value_en: Acquisition of two PSV-5000-class hybrid multi-purpose offshore support vessels, identified by hulls C430 and C431, to be built by the Detroit Brasil shipyard, in Itajai (SC).

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE DUAS EMBARCACOES DO TIPO SDSV (SHALLOW DIVING SUPPORT VESSEL), DENOMINADAS HUMAYTA E AMARALINA, A SEREM CONSTRUIDAS NO ESTALEIRO BELOV OFFSHORE INDUSTRIAL LTDA., EM SIMOES FILHO/BA.
value_en: Acquisition of two SDSV (shallow diving support vessel) type vessels, called Humayta and Amaralina, to be built at the Belov Offshore Industrial Ltda shipyard, in Simoes Filho/BA.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EMBARCACAO DE APOIO MARITIMO PARA MANUSEIO DE ANCORAS, REBOQUE E SUPRIMENTO, TIPO AHTS AH 05-AYP216, A SER CONSTRUIDA PELO ESTALEIRO AKER PROMAR S.A./RJ.
value_en: Acquisition of an offshore support vessel for anchor handling, towage and supply, AHTS AH 05-AYP216 type, to be built by the Aker Promar S.A./RJ shipyard.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EMBARCACAO, TIPO BATELAO LAMEIRO, COM PROPULSAOPROPRIA E 400 M3 DE CAPACIDADEDE DE CISTERNA, DESTINADA AOTRANSPORTE E DESPEJO DE MATERIAL ORIUNDO DE DRAGAGEM.
value_en: Acquisition of a mud-hopper barge vessel, with own propulsion and 400 m3 tank capacity, intended for transport and disposal of dredged material.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EMPRESA CONCORRENTE NA ATIVIDADE DE INJECAO E SOPRO DE PRE-FORMAS DE PET, COM CAPACIDADE INSTALADA PARA 12 MILHOES DE UNIDADES / ANO DE GARRAFAS E FRASCOS.
value_en: Acquisition of a competing company in the injection and blow moulding of PET preforms, with installed capacity for 12 million units/year of bottles and jars.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EMPRESAS E PATENTES, MODERNIZACAO E AMPLIACAO DA CAPACIDADE PRODUTIVA E INVESTIMENTOS SOCIAIS.
value_en: Acquisition of companies and patents, modernisation and expansion of production capacity, and social investments.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTO DENOMINADO CENTRO DE USINAGEM PARAFABRICACAO DE PERFIS EM FIBRA DE VIDRO E DE CARBONO, PERMITINDO A OBTENCAO DE PRODUTOS DE ANATOMIA COMPLEXA, BEM COMOCONSTRUCAO DE REFEITORIO E AREA DE LAZER, COMPLEMENTANDOAS INSTALACOES DA NOVA PLANTA EMPRESA.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment called a machining centre for manufacturing fibreglass and carbon fibre profiles, enabling complex-shaped products to be obtained, as well as construction of a cafeteria and leisure area, complementing the facilities of the company's new plant.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS A SEREM UTILIZADOS NA PRODUCAO DE SOLIDOS E OFTALMOLOGICOS E APOIO AS ATIVIDADES DE P&D DE NOVOS GENERICOS, DE NOVAS ASSOCIACOES DE PRODUTOS EM COMBINACAO FIXA, DE UM SISTEMA CARREADOR, DE NOVOS PRODUTOS DERMATOLOGICOS E DE MEDICAMENTOS FITOTERAPICOS.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment to be used in the production of solids and ophthalmic products, and support for R&D activities for new generics, new fixed-combination product associations, a carrier system, new dermatological products and herbal medicines.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS DE APOIO A SEREM INSTALADOS NO HOSPITAL D. PEDRO II.
value_en: Acquisition of support equipment to be installed at Hospital D. Pedro II.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS E ELEMENTOS DE IMAGEM PARA UTILIZACAO TANTO NOS POSTOS REVENDEDORES COMO NOS GRANDES CONSUMIDORES.
value_en: Acquisition of imaging equipment and elements for use both at resale service stations and at large consumers.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS E INSTALACOES ELETRICAS PARA A IMPLANTACAO DE ARMAZEM HORIZONTAL COM CAPACIDADE PARA 95.000 TONELADAS NA UNIDADE DE ESMAGAMENTO DE SOJA, EM PATO BRANCO/PR.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment and electrical installations for the construction of a horizontal warehouse with capacity for 95,000 tonnes at the soybean crushing unit, in Pato Branco/PR.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS E INSTRUMENTOS PARA O TEATRO DA RIBEIRA DOS ICOS - CE.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment and instruments for the Teatro da Ribeira dos Icos - CE.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS IMPORTADOS DE ESTUDIO, VISANDO A ADAPTACAO DA EMISSORA AO NOVO SISTEMA BRASILEIRO DE TV DIGITAL TERRESTRE (SBTVD-T).
value_en: Acquisition of imported studio equipment, aimed at adapting the broadcaster to the new Brazilian Digital Terrestrial TV System (SBTVD-T).

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS IMPORTADOS VISANDO A AMPLIACAO DA CAPACIDADE PRODUTIVA DE FIOS DE COBRE ESMALTADOS REDONDOS E RETANGULARES EM SUA UNIDADE FABRIL, LOCALIZADA NO MUNICIPIO DE TRES CORACOES - MG.
value_en: Acquisition of imported equipment aimed at expanding the production capacity of round and rectangular enamelled copper wire at its manufacturing unit, located in the municipality of Tres Coracoes - MG.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS NACIONAIS E MOBILIARIO.
value_en: Acquisition of domestic equipment and furniture.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS P/AMPLIACAO DE UNIDADE DE CO-GERA-CAO DE ENERGIA ELETRICA NA FAZENDA INVERNADA-MORRO AGUDO-SP;SUPLEMENTACAO DE RECURSOS DO FINANCIAMENTO CONTRATADO EM 07.04.2003 PARA EXPANSAO EM 35 MW DA CAPACIDADE DE COGERACAO DEENERGIA ELETRICA A PARTIR DO BAGACO DE CANA-DE-ACUCAR.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment for the expansion of an electricity co-generation unit at Fazenda Invernada-Morro Agudo-SP; supplementary funding for the financing contracted on 07.04.2003 for a 35 MW expansion of electricity co-generation capacity from sugarcane bagasse.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS PARA A EXTRACAO E TRANSPORTE DE MADEIRA FLORESTAL CERTIFICADA E REFORCO DE CAPITAL DE GIRO, VISANDO CONSOLIDAR A ATUACAO DA COOPERFLORESTA.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment for the extraction and transport of certified forest timber, and working capital reinforcement, aimed at consolidating Cooperfloresta's operations.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS PARA A UNIDADE ESMAGADORA DE SOJA,COM CAPACIDADE DE PROCESSAMENTO DE TRES MIL TONELADAS/DIA, EM DOURADOS/MS.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment for the soybean crushing unit, with processing capacity of three thousand tonnes/day, in Dourados/MS.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS PARA A UNIDADE ESMAGADORA DE SOJA,QUE TERA CAPACIDADE PARA PROCESSAR TRES MIL TONELADAS/DIA D E SOJA E PRODUZIR 720 TONELADAS/DIA DE OLEO DE SOJA REFINADO, EM DOURADOS/MS.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment for the soybean crushing unit, which will have capacity to process three thousand tonnes/day of soybeans and produce 720 tonnes/day of refined soybean oil, in Dourados/MS.

value_pt: AQUISICAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS, INSTALACOES E SERVICOS PARA A NOVA EDIFICACAO QUE ABRIGARA A COLECAO BIBLIOGRAFICA DA BIBLIOTECA BRASILIANA GUITA E JOSE MINDLIN DA UNIVERSIDADE DE SAO PAULO - USP. SALA EXPOSITIVA E ESPACO PARA ATENDIMENTO DE PESQUISADORES E VISITANTES.
value_en: Acquisition of equipment, facilities and services for the new building that will house the Biblioteca Brasiliana Guita e Jose Mindlin bibliographic collection of the University of Sao Paulo (USP), an exhibition room and a space for researchers and visitors.

value_en: Increase installed capacity, modernise the current facilities, train human resources, improve service quality and productivity, and invest in marketing actions, under the Programme for the Development of the National Software and Related Services Industry - PROSOFT-Company.

value_en: To strengthen sustainable production, culture and the way of life of the Kaxinawa do Rio Humaita, Arara do Igarape Humaita, Rio Gregorio and Alto Rio Purus indigenous lands, in the state of Acre, through the organisation and promotion of the agroforestry-product value chain and indigenous technical assistance.

value_en: To strengthen the cooperative's activities through investments for the inclusion of settled families in the coffee production chain, through financing of inputs, machinery and equipment, vehicles, construction of a coffee processing unit, and construction of a tasting room.

value_pt: FORTALECER CADEIAS PRODUTIVAS DA BIOECONOMIA NA AMAZONIA, GERANDO RENDA PARA AGRICULTORES FAMILIARES E COMUNIDADES TRADICIONAIS, VALORIZANDO A FLORESTA EM PE E CONTRIBUINDO PARA A REDUCAO DO DESMATAMENTO.

value_en: To strengthen and consolidate the value chains of socio-biodiversity products and community-based tourism of indigenous peoples, riverine communities and family farmers in the territories of the Rio Negro and Xingu river basins.

value_pt: FORTALECER E CONSOLIDAR CADEIAS SOCIOPRODUTIVAS SUSTENTAVEISE O COMERCIO RIBEIRINHO NA REGIAO DO RIO JURUA, PROMOVENDO O ENGAJAMENTO E FORTALECIMENTO DAS ORGANIZACOES COMUNITARIAS, A DIVERSIFICACAO DA PRODUCAO EXTRATIVISTA E A EXPANSAO DE OPORTUNIDADES DE COMERCIALIZACAO E GERACAO DE RENDA.
value_en: To strengthen and consolidate sustainable socio-productive chains and riverine trade in the Jurua river region, promoting the engagement and strengthening of community organisations, the diversification of extractivist production, and the expansion of marketing and income-generation opportunities.

value_pt: FORTALECER E MODERNIZAR A INFRA-ESTRUT URBANA E RURAL, PROMOVENDO O DESENV ECON E SOCIAL E A INTEGRACAO REGIONAL DO AC ATRAVES DE SUBPROJ COMO AMPLIACAO E MODERNIZ DO SIST DE CIRCULACAO DE RIO BRANCO; IMPLANT DE ASSENT FLORESTAIS E AGROFLORIMPLANT DO COMPLEXO FLORESTAL INDUSTR,REVIT PATRIM HISTORICO
value_en: To strengthen and modernise urban and rural infrastructure, promoting the economic and social development and regional integration of Acre through sub-projects such as expansion and modernisation of the Rio Branco traffic-circulation system; establishment of forestry and agroforestry settlements; implementation of the industrial forestry complex; and revitalisation of historical heritage.

value_pt: FORTALECER O CONTROLE, A FISCALIZACAO E O MONITORAMENTO AMBIENTAL REALIZADOS PELO IBAMA PARA O COMBATE E REDUCAO DO DESMATAMENTO NA AMAZONIA.
value_en: To strengthen the environmental control, inspection and monitoring carried out by IBAMA to combat and reduce deforestation in the Amazon.

value_en: To strengthen extractivism and family farming as drivers of development in the Calha Norte region of Para, through the establishment of food-processing units, seedling nurseries for agroforestry systems (SAFs), and a community carpentry workshop, in quilombola communities and settlements.

value_pt: FORTALECER O GERENCIAMENTO E A MELHORIA DO ATENDIMENTONO MUNICIPIO.
value_en: To strengthen management and improve services in the municipality.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA ATUACAO DO MUNICIPIO DE JUNDIAI (SP) NO COMBATE A VIOLENCIA E A CRIMINALIDADE.
value_en: Strengthening of the municipality of Jundiai's (SP) action to combat violence and crime.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA CADEIA PRODUTIVA DO MEL NA REGIAO NORTE DOESTADO DE GOIAS, POR MEIO DA IMPLANTACAO DE UM ENTREPOSTO D E MEL E CERA, DE UMA UNIDADE DE PROCESSAMENTO DE PROPOLIS EDE UMA MARCENARIA PARA A FABRICACAO DE COLMEIAS NO MUNICIPIODE PORANGATU (GO).
value_en: Strengthening of the honey production chain in the northern region of the state of Goias, through the establishment of a honey and wax depot, a propolis processing unit, and a carpentry workshop for hive manufacturing in the municipality of Porangatu (GO).

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA CAPACIDADE DE ENFRENTAMENTO AOS CRIMES AMBIENTAIS E CONEXOS RELACIONADOS A DINAMICA DO DESMATAMENTO E DEGRADACAO FLORESTAL PELAS FORCAS DE SEGURANCA PUBLICA NO AMBITO DO PLANO AMAZONIA: SEGURANCA E SOBERANIA - AMAS.
value_en: Strengthening of the capacity of public security forces to tackle environmental and related crimes linked to deforestation and forest degradation dynamics, under the Amazonia: Seguranca e Soberania (AMAS) Plan.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA FUNDACAO GILBERTO FREYRE ATRAVES DA RESTAURACAO DO CAMPUS DA FUNDACAO GILBERTO FREYRE; DA SALVAGUARDA E DIFUSAO DO ACERVO BIBLIOGRAFICO E DOCUMENTAL REUNIDO POR GILBERTO FREYRE; E DA PRESERVACAO, CONSERVACAO E SEGURANCA DOSEU ACERVO MUSEOLOGICO.
value_en: Strengthening of the Gilberto Freyre Foundation through the restoration of the Gilberto Freyre Foundation campus; the safeguarding and dissemination of the bibliographic and documentary collection compiled by Gilberto Freyre; and the preservation, conservation and security of its museum collection.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA GESTAO AMBIENTAL DO AMAZONAS EM AREAS SOB INTENSA PRESSAO PELO DESMATAMENTO, NOS MUNICIPIOS DE BOCA DOACRE, LABREA, APUI E NOVO ARIPUANA, POR MEIO DA ELAB. DOS M ARCOS LEGAIS NO ESTADO SOBRE CAR; INCENTIVO A PROMOCAO DA REGU. AMB. E FUND.; E APRIMORAM. MEC. LICENC./MONIT. AMBIENTAL
value_en: Strengthening of environmental management in Amazonas in areas under intense deforestation pressure, in the municipalities of Boca do Acre, Labrea, Apui and Novo Aripuana, through the drafting of the state's legal frameworks on the Rural Environmental Registry (CAR); promotion of land and environmental regularisation; and improvement of environmental licensing/monitoring mechanisms.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA GESTAO AMBIENTAL DOS MUNICIPIOS QUE INTEGRAM O BIOMA AMAZONIA POR MEIO DE ESTRATEGIAS COMBINADAS DE CAPACITACAO; ASSISTENCIA TECNICA DIRETA AOS GOVERNOS MUNICIPAIS; DISSEMINACAO DE INFORMACOES EM REDE E ESTIMULO A INOVACAO.
value_en: Strengthening of environmental management of municipalities within the Amazon biome through combined strategies of training; direct technical assistance to municipal governments; network information dissemination; and encouragement of innovation.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA GESTAO AMBIENTAL MUNICIPAL, POR MEIO DA ESTRUTURACAO FISICA E OPERACIONAL DA SECRETARIA MUNICIPAL DE MEIO AMBIENTE E TURISMO.
value_en: Strengthening of municipal environmental management, through the physical and operational structuring of the Municipal Secretariat for the Environment and Tourism.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA INFRAESTRUTURA DE PESQUISA DA UFPA VOLTADA PARA O ESTUDO DA BIODIVERSIDADE, COMPREENDENDO: (I) CONSTRUCAO E ESTRUTURACAO DO CENTRO DE ESTUDOS AVANCADOS DA BIODIVERSIDADE (CEABIO); (II) REFORMA E ESTRUTURACAO DE LABORATORIOS DE PESQUISA EM BIOTECNOLOGIA DA UFPA.
value_en: Strengthening of UFPA's research infrastructure for the study of biodiversity, comprising: (i) construction and structuring of the Centre for Advanced Biodiversity Studies (CEABIO); (ii) renovation and structuring of UFPA biotechnology research laboratories.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DA REDE DE ATENCAO A CRIANCA E AO ADOLECENTEDO MUNICIPIO POR MEIO DA CONSTRUCAO, EQUIPAMENTO E REFORMA DE HOSPITAIS, ESPACOS DESTINADOS A ATIVIDADES SOCIO-CULTURAIS, EDUCACIONAIS, RECREATIVAS E DESPORTIVAS.
value_en: Strengthening of the municipality's child and adolescent care network through the construction, equipping and renovation of hospitals, and spaces intended for socio-cultural, educational, recreational and sporting activities.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO DOS SIST DE CONTROLE E DE GESTAO DA BENEFICIARIA E MELHORIA DE SUA INFRAESTRUTURA OPERACIONAL, ATRAVESDA REALIZACAO DE INVESTIMENTO EM TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO,CAPACITACAO PROFISSIONAL E SERV TECNICOS ESPECIALIZADOS,ALEM DA AQUISICAO DE VEICULO E EQUIPAMENTOS.
value_en: Strengthening of the beneficiary's control and management systems and improvement of its operational infrastructure, through investment in information technology, professional training and specialised technical services, in addition to the acquisition of a vehicle and equipment.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO E EXPANSAO DA PRODUCAO VOLTADA PARA A TV, ESPECIALMENTE NO SEGMENTO DE FICCAO, ATRAVES DA IMPLANTACAO DE UM NUCLEO DE DESENVOLVIMENTO DE NOVOS PROJETOS E A PRODUCAO DE CONTEUDO AUDIOVISUAL.
value_en: Strengthening and expansion of production for TV, especially in the fiction segment, through the establishment of a new-project development unit and the production of audiovisual content.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO INSTITUCIONAL DA FUNDACAO OSB E DE SEUS CORPOS ARTISTICOS, ALEM DA REALIZACAO DE PROJETOS SOCIAIS E EDUCACIONAIS.
value_en: Institutional strengthening of the OSB Foundation and its artistic ensembles, in addition to the execution of social and educational projects.

value_pt: FORTALECIMENTO INSTITUCIONAL DE 51 BANCOS COMUNITARIOS, PORMEIO DE INVESTIMENTO EM EQUIPAMENTOS, SISTEMAS DE INFORMACAOE OUTROS COM O OBJETIVO DE APRIMORAR A ATUACAO DESSES BANCOSNO DESENVOLVIMENTO LOCAL.
value_en: Institutional strengthening of 51 community banks, through investment in equipment, information systems and other items, with the aim of improving these banks' performance in local development.

value_pt: GARANTIA FIRME ASSOCIADA A COORDENACAO DE OFERTA PUBLICA DE DEBENTURES SIMPLES INCENTIVADAS PELA LEI 12.431.
value_en: Firm underwriting associated with coordinating a public offering of simple debentures incentivised under Law 12,431.

value_pt: GARANTIR A INTEGRIDADE E ORGANIZACAO DO ACERVO, POR MEIO DA CONSTITUICAO DE UM QUADRO ARQUIVISTICO E O DESENVOLVIMENTO DE ACOES MUSEOLOGICAS NO CONJUNTO DE DOCUMENTOS FOTOGRAFICOS
value_en: To ensure the integrity and organisation of the collection, through the establishment of an archival framework and the development of museum-related actions on the set of photographic documents.

value_pt: HIGIENIZACAO E ACONDICIONAMENTO DE PARTE DO ACERVO E RESTAURO DE CODICES E DOCUMENTOS AVULSOS DOS SECULOS XVIII E XIX, ALEM DA MELHORIA DAS CONDICOES TECNICAS DO LABORATORIO DE CONSERVACAO E RESTAURO.
value_en: Cleaning and packaging of part of the collection and restoration of codices and loose documents from the 18th and 19th centuries, as well as improvement of the technical conditions of the conservation and restoration laboratory.

value_pt: HIGIENIZACAO E ACONDICIONAMENTO DE PARTE DO ACERVO, AQUISI CAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS PARA O LABORATORIO DE CONSERVACAO E RES TAURO, INSTALACAO DE SISTEMA INTERNO DE SEGURANA, ALEM DE RESTAURACAO DE TELAS E DE DOIS PIANOS HISTORICOS.
value_en: Cleaning and packaging of part of the collection, acquisition of equipment for the conservation and restoration laboratory, installation of an internal security system, as well as restoration of paintings and two historic pianos.

value_pt: HIGIENIZACAO E ACONDICIONAMENTO DE PARTE DO ACERVO.
value_en: Cleaning and packaging of part of the collection.

value_pt: HIGIENIZACAO, ACONDICIONAMENTO E CATALOGACAO DO ARQUIVO BERTA GLEIZER RIBEIRO; RESTAURACAO DE PELICULAS, FITAS-CASSETES, VHS E BETACAM RARAS, IMPLEMENTACAO DE SISTEMA DE SEGURANCA E GERENCIAMENTO AMBIENTAL NA RESERVA TECNICA.
value_en: Cleaning, packaging and cataloguing of the Berta Gleizer Ribeiro archive; restoration of rare film reels, cassette tapes, VHS and Betacam tapes; implementation of a security system and environmental management in the technical reserve.

value_pt: HIGIENIZACAO, ACONDICIONAMENTO E CATALOGACAO DOS ACERVOS DE TRES MUSEUS: CASA DE PEDRO AMERICO, MUSEU DO BREJO PARAIBANO E MUSEU REGIONAL, ALM DA REALIZACAO DE OBRAS DE ADEQUACAO DOS ESPACOS PARA MELHOR GERENCIAMENTO AMBIENTAL E INSTALACAO DE SISTEMAS DE SEGURANCA.
value_en: Cleaning, packaging and cataloguing of the collections of three museums: Casa de Pedro Americo, Museu do Brejo Paraibano and Museu Regional, as well as execution of works to adapt the spaces for better environmental management and installation of security systems.

value_pt: HIGIENIZAO E ACONDICIONAMENTO DE PARTE DO ACERVO
value_en: Cleaning and packaging of part of the collection.

value_pt: HISTRIAS DA AMAZONICA - 50 ANOS DE MEMORIA AUDIOVISUAL, VISANDO PRESERVACAO DO ACERVO DE FILMES DE ADRIAN COWEL SOBRE A AMAZONIA, ENVOLVENDO A CATALOGACAO, RESTAURACAO, O TRATAMENTO DOS FILMES, O GERENCIAMENTO AMBIENTAL E DE INFRAESTRUTURA, BEM COMO O OFERECIMENTO DE ACESSO PUBLICO AO ACERVO.
value_en: Amazon Histories - 50 years of audiovisual memory, aimed at preserving the film collection of Adrian Cowell on the Amazon, involving cataloguing, restoration, film treatment, environmental and infrastructure management, as well as providing public access to the collection.

value_pt: I MODERNIZACAO DA UNID. IND., USINA BATATAIS, LOCALIZADA BATATAIS/SP, AUMENTO EFICIENCIA IND MEDIDA AMPLIACAO DO INDICERECUP. TOTAL ACUCAR CRESCERA ATE 99,4% E IMPLANTACAO DE UM COA; II CAPITAL GIRO ASSOCIADO ITEM I; III RENOVACAO PLANTIOCANA-DE-ACUCAR EM AREA ATE 4,5 MIL HA E IMPLANTACAO NOVOS C ANAVIAIS AREA ATE 500 HA, ATE DEZ/21; IV AMPLIACAO REDE ADUTORAS VINHACA P/ FERTIRRIGACAO; V REFLORESTAMENTO APP AREAS BIOMAS CERRADO E MATA ATLANT. INVEST. III, IV E V A SEREM REALIZADOS ESTADO SP
value_en: I. Modernisation of the industrial unit, Usina Batatais, located in Batatais/SP, increase in industrial efficiency through expansion of the total sugar recovery rate (to grow to up to 99.4%) and installation of a COA (automated control centre); II. Working capital associated with item I; III. Renewal of sugarcane planting over an area of up to 4,500 ha and establishment of new cane fields over an area of up to 500 ha, by Dec/21; IV. Expansion of the vinasse pipeline network for fertigation; V. Reforestation of permanent-preservation areas (APP) in Cerrado and Atlantic Forest biome areas. Investments III, IV and V to be carried out in the state of Sao Paulo.

value_pt: I) DESENVOLVIMENTO E IMPLEMENTACAO DE SISTEMAS DE MONITORAMENTO DO DESMATAMENTO PARA OS BIOMAS MATA ATLANTICA, CAATINGA,PAMPA E PANTANAL; II) CALCULO DAS EMISSOES DE CO2 RELATIVAS AS AREAS DESMATADAS E CONSTRUCAO DE PROPOSTA DO NIVEL DE REFERENCIA DE EMISSOES FLORESTAIS (FREL) PARA CADA UM DESSES BIOMAS; E III) DESENVOLVIMENTO DE PLATAFORMA PARA ANALISE E VISUALIZACAO DE GRANDES VOLUMES DE DADOS GEOESPACIAIS.
value_en: I) Development and implementation of deforestation-monitoring systems for the Atlantic Forest, Caatinga, Pampa and Pantanal biomes; II) calculation of CO2 emissions relating to deforested areas and construction of a proposed Forest Reference Emission Level (FREL) for each of these biomes; and III) development of a platform for the analysis and visualisation of large volumes of geospatial data.

value_pt: I) INSTALAR UMA PLANTA PILOTO NO LABORATORIO DE ALIMENTOS DA UFPA PARA PRODUZIR E CARACTERIZAR EXTRATOS RICOS EM COMPOSTOS BIOATIVOS; II) DESENVOLVER NOVOS PRODUTOS E APLICACOES TECNOLOGICAS A PARTIR DE COMPOSTOS BIOATIVOS EXTRAIDOS DE PLANTAS E FRUTAS TIPICAS DA AMAZONIA ORIENTAL.
value_en: I) To install a pilot plant at the UFPA Food Laboratory to produce and characterise extracts rich in bioactive compounds; II) to develop new products and technological applications from bioactive compounds extracted from plants and fruits typical of eastern Amazonia.

value_pt: I) P&D DE CONHECIMENTOS E TECNICAS RELACIONADAS A REC. DE AREAS DEGRADADAS DE MANGUE NA R.NORTE;II) DES. DE MODELOS P/ ESTIMATIVA DA BIOMASSA, SEQUESTRO DE CARBONO E AVALIACAO DO ESTOQUE DE CARBONO DAS FLORESTAS DE MANGUE;III) AMPLIACAO E MELHORIA DA INFRAEST. DO LAB DE ECOLOGIA DE MANGUEZAL DA UFPA
value_en: I) R&D of knowledge and techniques related to the recovery of degraded mangrove areas in the North region; II) development of models for estimating biomass, carbon sequestration and assessing the carbon stock of mangrove forests; III) expansion and improvement of the infrastructure of the UFPA Mangrove Ecology Laboratory.

value_pt: I. AMPLIACAO DA CAPACIDADE ESTATICA, EM ATE 15 MIL TONELADAS, NA UNIDADE DE RECEPCAO, BENEFICIAMENTO E ARMAZENAGEM DE GRAOS EM ITAIPULANDIA/PR; II. IMPLANTACAO DE UMA FABRICA DE FARINHA DE PENAS NA UNIDADE INDUSTRIAL DE AVES LOCALIZADA EM CASCAVEL/PR; III. AMPLIACAO DA CAPACIDADE DE ABATE PARA ATE 185 MIL AVES/DIA EM CADA UMA DAS UNIDADES INDUSTRIAIS DE AVES EM ROLANDIAE MARECHAL CANDIDO RONDON/PR; E IV - AMPLIACAO DA CAPACIDADE PRODUTIVA, ATE 60 T/H, DA UNIDADE INDUSTRIAL DE RACOES EM ROLANDIA

value_pt: MODERNIZAR A ADMINISTRACAO MUNICIPAL, IMPLANTANDO PROJETOS DE GESTAO QUE VISAM DISPONIBILIZAR NOVAS TECNOLOGIAS PARA AMPLIAR CAPACIDADES GERENCIAL, ADMINISTRATIVA E DE CONTROLE DO MUNICIPIO.
value_en: Modernise municipal administration by implementing management projects aimed at making new technologies available to expand the municipality's managerial, administrative and control capacities.

value_pt: MODERNIZAR A GESTAO DO INTERESSADO POR MEIO DE INVESTIMENTOSNAS AREAS DE ADMINISTRACAO TRIBUTARIA, FINANCEIRA, PATRIMON IAL E GERAL.

value_en: Modernise the management of the municipality of Itu/SP, through investments in the areas of general, tax, budgetary, financial and property administration, and the basic social sectors (health and education).

value_pt: MODERNIZAR A GESTAO TRIBUTARIA, ADMINISTRATIVA E DA GESTAO DAS SECRETARIAS MUNICIPAIS PRESTADORAS DE SERVICOS A COLETIVIDADE, BUSCANDO A IMPLANTACAO DE UM NOVO MODELO DE GESTAO E PLANEJAMENTO DAS OPERACOES DA CIDADE, DE MODO A PROPORCIONAR EFICIENCIA NA PRESTACAO DOS SERVICOS E CONTRIBUIR PARA A MELHORIA DA QUALIDADE DE VIDA DA POPULACAO.
value_en: Modernise tax and administrative management, and the management of the municipal secretariats providing services to the community, seeking to implement a new model for managing and planning the city's operations, so as to provide efficiency in service delivery and contribute to improving the population's quality of life.

value_pt: MODIFICAR AS LINHAS DE PRODUCAO DO PALIO, COM VISTAS A SUBS-TITUICAO DESTE PELO NOVO 178, EM BETIM/MG.
value_en: Modify the Palio production lines, with a view to replacing it with the new 178, in Betim/MG.

value_pt: MONITORAR, POR MEIO DE PLATAFORMA ONLINE, A IMPLEMENTACAO DACONECTIVIDADE NAS ESCOLAS MUNICIPAIS BENEFICIARIAS DA SELEC AO PUBLICA BNDES-FUST 01/2024.
value_en: Monitor, through an online platform, the implementation of connectivity in the municipal schools benefiting from the BNDES-FUST 01/2024 public selection process.

value_en: Modernisation, expansion of the production capacity of the tire factories located in Campinas/SP, Feira de Santana/BA and Gravatai/RS, and of the wire rope factory of Cord Brasil Ind. e Comercio de Cordas Metalicas Ltda, in Sumare/SP.

value_pt: MOSTRA AUDIOVISUAL DE PRODUES PREMIADAS E PRODUZIDAS EM TODO O MUNDO, QUE NORMALMENTE NO ESTO NO CIRCUITO TELEVISIVONACIONAL. HAVER SESSES ESPECIAIS P/ O PBLICO ESCOLAR E P/PROFESSORES, SEGUIDAS DE PALESTRAS.
value_en: Audiovisual showcase of award-winning productions made around the world, which are usually not shown on the national television circuit. There will be special sessions for school audiences and teachers, followed by talks.

value_pt: MOSTRA DE CINEMA DE OURO PRETO SE PROPE A DISCUTIR A PRESERVAO E MEMRIA DO PATROMNIO CINEMATOGRFICO BRASILEIRO.
value_en: The Ouro Preto Film Festival aims to discuss the preservation and memory of Brazilian cinematographic heritage.

value_pt: MOSTRA INTERNACIONAL DE MUSICA EM OLINDA MIMO
value_en: Olinda International Music Showcase (MIMO).

value_pt: MPLANTAO DE 47 LOJAS E REFORMA DE OUTRAS 7.
value_en: Construction of 47 stores and renovation of another 7.

value_pt: NACIONALIZACAO DA PRODUCAO DE COMPONENTES AUTOMOTIVOS E MODERNIZACAO DO PROCESSO FABRIL
value_en: Domestic production of automotive components, and modernisation of the manufacturing process.

value_pt: NACIONALIZACAO DE COMPONENTES, DESENVOLVIMENTO DE MELHORIAS EM PRODUTOS E ADEQUACAO DA ESTRUTURA FABRIL EM SETE LAGOAS (MG), BEM COMO PROJETO SOCIAL NO AMBITO DA COMUNIDADE EM SETE LAGOAS E CONTAGEM (MG).
value_en: Domestic production of components, development of product improvements, and adaptation of the manufacturing structure in Sete Lagoas (MG), as well as a community social project in Sete Lagoas and Contagem (MG).

value_pt: NACIONALIZACAO DE PRODUTOS E MODERNIZACAO DAS UNIDADES INDUSTRIAIS DE CONTAGEM (MG), CURITIBA (PR), SOROCABA E PIRACICABA (SP) E PROJETO SOCIAL NA COMUNIDADE, EM CONTAGEM (MG).
value_en: Domestic production of products and modernisation of the industrial units in Contagem (MG), Curitiba (PR), Sorocaba and Piracicaba (SP), and a community social project in Contagem (MG).
